# Anne Shirley & Matthew Cuthbert

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) — best of friends · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), +1 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) expresses shock upon discovering she is a girl rather than the expected boy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears when she realizes she is not wanted, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay overnight in the east gable room. After putting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists on sending her back, while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently suggests they might keep her.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the surrounding landscape from her window before being told by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to dress and come down for breakfast. After eating with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and a quiet [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) washes the dishes and names Marilla's geranium Bonny. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to settle her return arrangements.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness and saying bedtime prayers. After finding out [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites in an unorthodox manner. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and complains to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about Anne's lack of religious upbringing, resolving to educate her.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. Lynde so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. Lynde, who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and her mother. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly become friends in the garden, solemnly swearing eternal friendship. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her new friend, and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) surprises [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of chocolate sweeties.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) concocts a false confession in hopes of being allowed to go to the Sunday school picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) still forbids her from going. However, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) soon discovers the brooch snagged in her lace shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and sends her off to enjoy the picnic.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to attend the Sunday school picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed by the day's excitement and ice cream, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later recounts the whole incident to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that she accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to ban [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with her. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to clear up the mistake, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) refuses to listen. Desperate, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) herself to plead for forgiveness, but is coldly turned away.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during the night, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert with their classmates, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), unaware that Diana's [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is sleeping in it. The surprise causes [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) to react angrily, threatening to cut short her visit and cancel Diana's music lessons until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take responsibility.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) admits her fault to Mrs. Lynde before walking over to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Anne's brave and earnest explanation amuses [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue Diana's music lessons. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) become great friends during her month-long stay.
>

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to a fall that breaks Anne's ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visitors, reflects on her mistakes, and looks forward to returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and flourishes under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) organizes a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag, throwing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the other students into excited preparations despite Marilla's skepticism. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), finding steady support and encouragement in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> Noticing how plainly [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is dressed compared to her friends, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) attempts to buy her a trendy puffed-sleeve dress at a store, though he ends up flustered and gets help from Mrs. Lynde instead. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the stylish dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) as well as a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). She later wears her new outfit to the school concert, where she performs brilliantly.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) present of kid slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). They participate in the evening concert, which is a great success, and walk home together discussing the performances. Afterward, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit by the fire and express their pride in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), briefly discussing her future education.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home to find [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hiding in her room after accidentally dying her red hair a terrible shade of green using dye bought from a peddler. When washing the dye out fails, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) cuts Anne's hair short, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later resolves to bear the resulting embarrassment as penance.
>

> As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return next year to prepare the class for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts away her books for the summer to enjoy her childhood, while Mrs. Lynde visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises Anne's remarkable growth and improvement over the past three years.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful, active summer outdoors on the [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) doctor's orders before returning to her studies in autumn. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) observes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) growing up into a quieter, taller young woman and privately grieves the passing of Anne's childhood.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results of the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joyful news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. Lynde before going to sleep feeling grateful.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), assisted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and checked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After driving over with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences severe stage fright on the hotel platform, but recovers upon seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd and performs brilliantly to enthusiastic applause.

> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. > Following her successful recitation and encore at the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is warmly praised by the guests, including a stout pink lady and Mrs. [Evans](../character/evans.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) join [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for supper before they leave with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) in his carriage, chatting about wealth, compliments from an artist, and being content with who they are.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who grows emotional reflecting on how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) means to them. Upon arriving in town, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to her new living arrangements and classes, feeling a mix of rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and homesickness. Her spirits are lifted when [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby visit, bringing news that Queen's will award an Avery scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P0](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P5](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)_

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies after reading a notice about the failure of the Abbey Bank. After his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. Allan about finding moments of joy amidst her sorrow, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her past romantic history with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's father.
